title: Path of Exile 2 0.5.4 Hotfix Rollup — Verisium, Migration and Oath Rune
summary: The thin 0.5.4 Hotfixes, 0.5.4d migration and the Oath Rune Hotfix, merged into one problem-to-fix timeline so they are not lost as separate thin pages.
description: Single-page rollup of the 0.5.4 Hotfix 1-2, 0.5.4d migration and the 0.5.4d Oath Rune Hotfix. Each sub-patch keeps its own node in the timeline.
patch: Path of Exile 2 Early Access 0.5.4 Hotfixes
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: A storm-darkened ruined city representing the 0.5.4 Hotfix rollup

versions.summary: Merchant Stash item loss, Liquid Verisium stack purchase, and several Expedition Atlas behaviour fixes.
Migrate All now moves Ritual Offered Tribute and Breach League resources and tree unlocks.
Fixed Oath Rune sometimes spawning an invincible monster. Must be separate from the 0.5.4d migration notes.

cards.detail: Merchant Stash item loss was addressed in the early Hotfixes; traders should re-verify before bulk moves.
Buying a stack returning one item was fixed; the Item page notes the corrected behaviour.
Migrate All now carries Ritual Tribute and Breach resources; SSF and Private League players are the main audience.
The invincible-monster case was fixed in the 0.5.4d Hotfix, distinct from the migration notes.

changes.title: Merchant Stash item loss
changes.detail: Items could be lost through the Merchant Stash; fixed in the early 0.5.4 Hotfixes.

changes.title: Liquid Verisium stack purchase
changes.detail: Buying a stack returned a single item; fixed so the full stack is granted.

changes.title: Expedition Atlas +1 area level
changes.detail: An Atlas node incorrectly granting +1 area level was corrected.

changes.title: Double or Nothing UI
changes.detail: A UI issue with the Double or Nothing interaction was resolved.

changes.title: Ritual / Breach migration
changes.detail: 0.5.4d Migrate All now moves Ritual Offered Tribute and Breach League resources and tree unlocks.
changes.scope: official-fact: affects SSF / Private League Guides

changes.title: Oath Rune invincible monster
changes.detail: 0.5.4d Hotfix fixed Oath Rune sometimes spawning an invincible monster.
changes.scope: official-fact: affects Expedition / Oath Rune pages

sections.title: Migration checklist
sections.oldText: Migrate All moved characters and stash but left Ritual Tribute and Breach resources behind for many players.
sections.newText: Migrate All now also moves Ritual Offered Tribute and Breach League resources and tree unlocks.
